b'# tinydl

A minimal command-line downloader.

## Usage

```
tinydl <url> [options]
```

## CLI options

| Option | Help text |
|--------|-----------|
| `url`  | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |
'
